response_json.request: Hi , Please remove the fillet at the front center and add a 1 millimeter chamfer instead

actions.target: The fillet at the front center of the model
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the specific existing fillet described as being at the front center
steps: Orient the model normal to the front side and use the wheel rotation axis, which is the STEP Y-axis, to identify the coaxial center geometry.

Localize the requested feature to the outer front edge of the main hub collar in section S02, where the planar Front hub annulus, face code 0007 and Brep FACE 667, transitions toward the Conical hub transition, face code 0010 and Brep FACE 432.

Confirm that the selected transition is the circular front-center blend surrounding the hub and leading into the spoke-root region. Do not select the Hub entry chamfer at face code 0008 or the Splined hub insert Front outer chamfer at face code 0001, because both are existing chamfers at the insert-receiving opening rather than the requested fillet.
Confirm from the front and top-right isometric views that the selected blend belongs to the wheel-body hub collar and not to the separate splined hub insert solid S01.

If native feature history is available, locate and suppress or delete the fillet feature that creates the selected annular front-center blend while retaining all unrelated spoke-root and opening fillets.

If editing the imported STEP geometry directly, select the annular fillet face or connected fillet-face chain adjacent to faces 0007 and 0010, apply a delete-face operation with heal or patch enabled, and extend the adjacent parent surfaces until they intersect.

Verify that removal produces a continuous sharp annular edge at the former fillet location without changing the insert-receiving diameter, the front hub annulus, the separate insert solid, or the spoke openings.
Inspect the healed result for gaps, sliver faces, or unintended deletion of the conical load-spreading transition, and confirm that the wheel-body solid remains valid.

actions.target: The geometry at the front center from which the fillet is removed
actions.relational_constraint: Replace the removed front-center fillet with the chamfer
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the exact edge or edges previously forming the front-center fillet; the chamfer dimensioning method is not explicitly specified
steps: Use the newly restored sharp annular edge between the Front hub annulus, face code 0007 and Brep FACE 667, and the Conical hub transition, face code 0010 and Brep FACE 432, as the chamfer edge selection.

Apply the chamfer only to the complete connected circular edge chain at the front-center hub collar; do not propagate the selection into spoke-root edges, the internal spline, or the separate insert solid.

Create a 1 millimeter chamfer using the CAD system's symmetric equal-distance chamfer definition. Where the system requires distance and angle, use a 1 millimeter by 45 degree chamfer as the conventional interpretation of an unspecified 1 millimeter chamfer.
Ensure the chamfer removes material from the wheel-body hub collar and replaces the former rounded transition with a single planar or conical chamfer band around the full circumference.

No new sketch or extrusion is required because this is an edge-treatment operation. If the direct chamfer command cannot resolve the healed imported edge, create a radial section sketch on a plane containing the STEP Y-axis, draw the 1 millimeter chamfer profile at the same corner, and perform a revolved cut through 360 degrees about the wheel axis.
Regenerate the model and verify in the front view that the new chamfer is concentric with the spline insert and visually continuous around the front center.

Verify in side and isometric views that the chamfer is applied only on the front side and that the non-mirror-identical rear hub geometry, including the rear hub blend and rear annular seat, remains unchanged.

Run solid-validity and interference checks to confirm that both original solids remain separate, the splined insert fit is unchanged, and the 1 millimeter chamfer does not break through the hub collar or weaken adjacent spoke roots.
